source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
This companion adds to the Warhammer Event Companion for Teams Events, where teams face each other and each member plays a battle against 1 member of the opposing team. It covers:

- Warhammer Teams Event Mission Sequence: changes to the usual steps for generating a mission and preparing the battlefield.
- Pairings and Rankings: how to pair players fairly and decide rankings.

For everything else, such as errata and FAQs, use the Warhammer Event Companion.

detail.opponent: one member of the opposing team
